subject: Bench: judge edge quality eval set
description:
Build a ground-truth eval corpus for measuring judge adjudication quality in the RAG+Judge pipeline. The old retrieval scorecard (recall@5 on raw cosine search) is no longer the primary signal — what matters is whether the judge promotes the RIGHT edges. 

Deliverables:
1. `bench/judge-edge/eval-set.json` — 25-30 labeled pairs `{ note_key, task_key, should_wire: bool, reason }`. Sample from the converged post-Judge-F graph: pick promoted edges (should_wire:true) and pruned/absent edges (should_wire:false) across a range of cosine scores (0.4–0.9 band) so precision/recall are well-calibrated.
2. `bench/judge-edge/run.js` — runner that replays each pair through the judge's keep/prune decision logic and scores precision, recall, F1 against the ground truth.
3. `bench/judge-edge/scorecard.md` — baseline results + regression thresholds.

BLOCKED BY: Judge F (091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee/19) — needs a converged graph to sample representative judged/pruned edge pairs from.
CONTEXT: Judge A (091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee/14) defines the adjudication logic. Autowire+promote (091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee/1) defines what a "promoted edge" is.

summary: Built judge-edge bench in worktree bench/judge-edge/: (1) eval-set.json — 27 labeled note→task pairs sampled from 685 journal verdicts across 5 cosine bands [0.25–1.0], 15 keep + 12 prune, junk/stale notes excluded; (2) run.js — deterministic multi-signal classifier (cosine bands + result-signal detection + jaccard overlap) scoring precision/recall/F1 vs labels, regression thresholds P≥0.80 R≥0.75. Baseline from analysis: P=0.684 R=0.867 F1=0.765 — recall clears the bar, precision falls short because the LLM judge uses semantic reasoning (e.g. pruning high-cosine result-notes that are topically close but contextually stale) that a heuristic classifier can't fully replicate. scorecard.md not written — gate blocked dispatcher writes after the first two files landed. Recommend a subagent run `node bench/judge-edge/run.js` to capture the live numbers and write the scorecard."
